title: Cross-Platform Production Signatures of State-Linked Information Operations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27137v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An information operation active on several platforms presents different names, personas, and topics on each. Its working routine is harder to change. We call this routine the operation's production signature: the regularities in when and how its accounts post, reply, and repost. We measure it from timestamps and coarse action types only, using no content, profile metadata, or network ties, as timing and action profiles for accounts and learned action-gap policies for populations. We then ask which parts of a signature carry over to another platform and which belong to a single operation. We train models on Twitter archives of four state-linked operations and apply them to Internet Research Agency (IRA) accounts on Reddit, with no Reddit training labels. translated_title: 国家关联信息操作的跨平台生产特征
translated_abstract: 活跃于多个平台的信息操作在每个平台上会呈现不同的名称、人设和话题，但其工作惯例却更难改变。我们将这种惯例称为该操作的“生产特征”：即其账号在何时以及如何发帖、回复和转发的规律性。我们仅通过时间戳和粗粒度的行为类型来度量这一特征，不使用任何内容、个人资料元数据或网络关系，具体做法是对单个账号采用时间与行为分布刻画，对账号群体采用学习得到的行为间隔策略刻画。在此基础上，我们探究特征中的哪些部分能够迁移到另一个平台，哪些只属于单个操作。我们在四个国家关联操作的Twitter档案上训练模型，并将其应用于Reddit上的“互联网研究局”（IRA）账号，全程未使用任何Reddit训练标签。模型对IRA账号的识别达到0.90–0.94的AUC，而走同样路线的内容检测器性能则从平台内的0.98降至0.81。日常节奏解释了大部分的迁移能力（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“生产特征”概念——仅凭时间戳和粗粒度行为类型刻画信息操作账号的发帖规律，并证明这些行为规律可跨平台迁移，在无任何Reddit标签的情况下以0.90–0.94的AUC识别出IRA账号，显著优于会因平台切换而大幅退化的内容检测方法。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "production signatures" — regularities in when and how accounts post, reply, and repost, measured solely from timestamps and coarse action types — and demonstrates that these behavioral regularities transfer across platforms, detecting IRA accounts on Reddit at AUC 0.90–0.94 without any Reddit training labels, while content-based detectors degrade sharply across platforms.
